summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 results and a CEO transition. On February 23, 2026, Clive Johnson decided to retire as President, CEO, and Director effective June 4, 2026, as part of leadership succession planning. Mike Cinnamond, previously SVP Finance and CFO, will succeed him as President and CEO and join the Board. Johnson will be named Chair Emeritus. The filing also reported repurchase of $80 million. No deal terms apply. Watch for operational continuity under new leadership.
